name: Your Soul
overview: Scripture reveals that the soul is the life given by God, formed when He breathed life into man, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). The soul is deeply personal and accountable before God, as all souls belong to Him and the soul that sins shall die (Ezekiel 18:4, 20). God cares for the soul’s restoration and guidance toward righteousness (Psalms 23:3), yet the soul also faces spiritual challenges and doubts, as seen in the psalmist’s cry for help amidst adversity (Psalms 3:2). Ultimately, at death, the physical returns to dust while the spirit returns to God who gave it (Ecclesiastes 12:7), underscoring the soul’s eternal significance.
